fields.name: items
fields.coerce: `Number.isInteger` on each `[1]`, with no conversion. The string `"3"` fails with `invalid`
fields.description: The ingredients, 1 to 9 entries. Each entry is an array. The server reads only `[1]`, the inventory slot. `[0]` has no effect: the official client puts the cell of the crafting grid there. Two entries must not have the same slot.

confirm.note: The handler reads only `items`, and of each entry only `[1]`

responses.name: Success
responses.when: All checks pass. The server takes the gold, removes the ingredients and adds the result.

fields.name: num
fields.description: The slot that got the result.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The result. It is `G.craft[recipe].output.name` when the recipe has an `output`, else the recipe name.

fields.name: cevent
fields.description: Tells the official client to fire its `craft` code event.

rows.when: No character, or the character is in the bank.
`items` is not an array, is empty or has more than 9 entries. Or an entry is not an array, its `[1]` is not an integer from 0 to the inventory length - 1, or two entries have the same slot.
An ingredient has the lock `l`, the flag `b` or `giveaway`. The server checks this before it checks for empty slots.
A slot in the list is empty.
The sorted list of ingredient names matches no recipe in `D.craftmap`. A name gets `+<level>` when the item has a level above 0.
The recipe has `quest: "anniversary_baker"`, and the anniversary event is not active or that NPC is not present.
The recipe has no `quest`, and you are more than `B.sell_dist` (400 px) from the `craftsman` NPC on `main`. A character with a `computer` passes this check.
The recipe has a `quest`, and you are more than `B.sell_dist` (400 px) from that quest NPC. A character with a `computer` passes this check.
No ingredient stack becomes empty, and the result does not fit in the inventory.
A stack has fewer units than the recipe needs.

also.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`. `items`, `esize` and `gold` show the craft.

also.when: Success, when the result is rare (the count of announcements of this item on the server is below `G.items[name].a`), or when the result got `p: "shiny"`. Not when you are `stealth`.

confirm.note: `r: 1` gives the shiny roll (1/500 for an upgrade item, 1/20000 for a compound item), which always announces

order: `server_message` to everyone, only for a rare or shiny result
